title: Unit Event — Our Constellation of Song — Episode2 Expressing How I Feel

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has done it at last. They've been signed by a record label! Reflecting on all of the people whose support has taken them this far, Ichika thinks of a way for the band to show their gratitude.

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I was so nervous!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But it was also a relief to hear that all our contracts were in order...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I'd been feeling anxious about today for so long. We can finally relax a little...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But signing with a label wasn't our goal. We still have a lot of work ahead of us...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. We'll need to start thinking about what's going to happen moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But for now, we should just follow Mr. Shindo's advice and keep practicing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In any case, we've done what we needed to today, so let's go home...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. And it's already getting dark...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Getting dark... Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um... I was just reminded of something I saw on the news this morning.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The news?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Apparently, the Perseid meteor shower is happening soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The Pe-Pe-Pep... Peperoncino meteor shower?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Was that supposed to be a joke?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Hey, I couldn't hear what she said clearly!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. The Perseid meteor shower, yes?
It's one of the three biggest meteor showers you can see in Japan. And the timing does seem right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Really...?
I had no idea.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
A meteor shower...
Remember the one we saw when we were little? Good times.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That one was the Leonid meteor shower...
But yes, it's quite nostalgic.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...! I felt the same way this morning.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I was hoping that we could see another one together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Another one...together...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ye...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! Absolutely!
We've gotta go see it!!!!!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree...
Between shows and contract stuff, we haven't been able to take a break recently.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd like to see it as well...
I still remember that night sky like I saw it yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Not only that, the wish Saki made...
What we talked about. All of it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
They're all precious memories.
And it'd be wonderful to add more to our album.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Then, let's go see it.
Like we did all those years ago.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This is so great...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We made plans to go see it together without a second thought.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I can't wait to see this meteor shower.)
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
I'm glad I was able to get some new picks and replacement strings.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Since we're pros now, I need to stay stocked up. Next is...)
Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yoshizaki, it's been so long...!
Also, what a coincidence. I wasn't expecting to run into you in the middle of town like this...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Me neither...!
Sorry, I hope I didn't scare you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, it's great to see you!
How have things been since then?

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Oh, I need to thank you again for what you did!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: And... I apologize for not being able to go to your shows lately...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: The thing is, I made a promise with Hanano...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A promise? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Let's see another show again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Once you've settled in at home... Promise, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: I promised her that we'd go see you guys perform once she's had a chance to settle in with her new family.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: So, I felt I should hold off until she can be there to join me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I see.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: However, I think that we'll be able to go soon...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Yes, Hanano seems to be getting along really well with her new family! They even went on a trip together the other day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really...?! I'm so glad to hear that...!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Me too! So, we've been talking about going to see Leo/need's next show together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I see... Thank goodness...
They get to be together again...)

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: And Leo/need made this all possible...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, us...?

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Hanano told me that.
When she first moved in with her new family, there were times when she felt really lonely...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: But whenever that happened, she said she always thought about the last time she saw you guys perform.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
And I know what she means.
There are times when I find myself wondering if she's okay...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: But whenever I think about the song you played during that show...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: I'm reminded of the time Hanano and I spent together. It fills me with so much joy.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Also, I've listened to it more times than I can count since you guys uploaded it online. Leo/need has been a huge source of encouragement for both of us...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: So, thank you all very much...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's so touching to hear...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I should be the one thanking you two.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You both taught me something incredibly valuable.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Before, I just kinda wished that someone would feel moved by our music or understand what we were trying to do...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But you two reminded me of what the old me went through...
You two made me want to write a song that you'd both feel a real connection to.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I mentioned this during that show, but there was a time when my friends and I began drifting apart.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
As hard as that was...
I was glad my experience helped me create a song that connected with you two so strongly.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, I want to keep doing that...
I want to keep playing music that gives people support and encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's what you two taught me.
Which is why I need to thank you...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
No, I...
Still, Hoshino, that does mean a lot coming from you.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget!
Do you know when you'll be performing next?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, about that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(We need to discuss that with our label...
That's not something we can decide on our own now.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, we don't have any fixed plans...
But we will be doing one soon!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We promise to make it an unbelievable show that really resonates with you, so we hope you'll make it!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Of course! Hanano and I will be looking forward to seeing it!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Anyway, if you'll excuse me.
Thanks for stopping to chat!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: And you can always count on us for support!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm so glad...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Hanano and her brother get to be together again.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I couldn't be happier that our song helped them through such a tough period of their lives.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (The joy of playing a song with someone specific in mind, and of successfully reaching them...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Those two taught me what that was like.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(They're not the only ones who've taught me something important...
We were able to make it this far because we had help from a lot of different people.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Iori was the reason why we really began thinking about going pro. And she gave us a ton of valuable advice...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saku's band pushed us to become better when we battled against them.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And of course, all of our friends have supported us in our dream...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Including...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Miku and them have been watching over us this entire time...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I don't think we can even begin to thank them enough.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I wish we could repay everyone somehow. They've all done so much...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But how can we do that...?)
